title: Enchanted Masquerade Mask
description: A highly detailed sculpted mask featuring a serene feminine face with gold-trimmed eye openings and a gentle smile. The surface is painted with a whimsical fantasy scene showing a glowing alchemy laboratory on the forehead, complete with potion bottles, books, and a candle, while three small pink pigs sit on a flowering branch on the right cheek against a cloudy night sky background.
